parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
The personal access token.
This field is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AK/SK pair or STS temporary authorization.

parameters.name: authorIds
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account IDs of the creators. Multiple IDs are separated by commas.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description:
The end of the creation time range.


> ISO 8601 format, such as 2019-03-15T08:00:00Z. The comparison is "less than".


> The creation time range is [createdBefore, createdAfter), which is a left-closed, right-open interval.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description:
The start of the creation time range.

> ISO 8601 format, such as 2019-03-15T08:00:00Z. The comparison is "greater than or equal to".

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
Filters merge requests by version. By default, no filtering is applied and both new and legacy merge requests are returned. If you have always used the new merge request version, you can ignore this parameter. Valid values:
- new: queries only new merge requests.
- old: queries only legacy merge requests.

parameters.name: groupIds
parameters.description: The code group IDs. Multiple IDs are separated by commas.

parameters.name: labelIds
parameters.description: The label IDs. Multiple IDs are separated by commas.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description:
The field by which to sort results. Default value: updated_at. Valid values:
- created_at: creation time.
- updated_at: update time.

If an invalid value is passed, updated_at is used by default.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID, in string format. You can obtain this ID from the Yunxiao access URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/<OrganizationId>.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: projectIds
parameters.description: The repository IDs. Multiple IDs are separated by commas.

parameters.name: reviewerIds
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account IDs of the reviewers. Multiple IDs are separated by commas.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: The search keyword. Matches against the merge request title.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:
- desc: descending order.
- asc: ascending order.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description:
The merge request state. By default, merge requests in all states are queried. Valid values:
- opened: open, including the under review, to be merged, and under development states.
- closed: closed.
- merged: merged.
- all: all states. If the value is all, you do not need to pass this parameter. Other invalid characters also default to querying all states.
